what: Make `prismis-daemon refetch` add a Hacker News story's discussion the way the live RSS fetch does, through the one shared discussion method, so HN stories stored title-only before hn-discussion shipped can be recovered.
why: Design: docs/work/refetch-hn-discussion/design.md. On cerebro on 2026-10-10, 39 non-archived HN stories hold only the feed's comments link and stay title-only on refetch, because refetch's rss branch re-extracts the article alone and never reads the discussion.

criteria.given: a real test database holding a title-only HN story whose stored content is the feed's comments link, an article URL that returns 403, and recorded HN API responses with comments
criteria.when: run_refetch runs for source type rss
criteria.then: it fails if the item is not stored readable with content_basis = "discussion", the discussion's comments in its content and the report counting it recovered; otherwise all three hold, and the test is shown red with the discussion step removed from refetch

criteria.given: the same story whose article URL now returns a readable article
criteria.then: it fails if the content lacks the article or the discussion, or the analysis carries a content_basis key; otherwise it holds both and no content_basis

criteria.given: an HN story whose discussion has no comments, and one whose HN API read fails (recorded 500)
criteria.then: it fails if either is stored readable or counted recovered, or the failed read leaves no comments_outcome on the item; otherwise both stay title-only, both are counted still title-only, and the failed one records comments_outcome {outcome: fetch_failed}

criteria.given: an Ask/Show HN self post whose url is its own news.ycombinator.com/item?id=<id> page
criteria.then: it fails if article extraction is attempted against the HN page or the item's own text from the API is not the body; otherwise the body is the item text followed by its comments

criteria.given: an rss row whose stored content holds no HN item link
criteria.then: it fails if any HN API request is made for it or its result differs from refetch before this change; otherwise none is made and it is refetched article-only

criteria.given: the source tree after the change
criteria.then: it fails if refetch.py fetches or formats HN comments itself instead of calling the RSS fetcher's discussion method, or if the HN item-link pattern is defined twice; otherwise both callers share one method and one pattern
it fails on any failing check; otherwise its last line is `verify: PASS`

outOfScope: The story id is recovered from the stored content; a row whose content no longer holds the item link refetches article-only (none on cerebro on 2026-10-10: all 39 unreadable HN rows hold it).
Items already readable but judged not substantive (8 HN items on cerebro) are not refetched, as refetch selects only unreadable content.
Running the backfill on cerebro waits on the operator, with the affected items and cost stated first.
stakes: Refetching a stored title-only HN story whose article still fails and whose discussion has comments stores it readable, with content_basis = "discussion" and a summary of the discussion, proven through run_refetch against a real test database with the article and HN API responses recorded.
A story whose article now loads is recovered from the article plus its discussion, with no content_basis key, the same result a live fetch gives.

A story with no comments, or whose discussion read fails, stays title-only; the failure is recorded on the item as comments_outcome, and the refetch report counts it as still title-only, not recovered.
An rss row whose stored content holds no HN item link is refetched exactly as before this change.
The discussion is fetched and appended by one method that both the live RSS fetch and refetch call; no copy of that logic exists in refetch.py.
